notablePrerequisites: Jace has at least five loyalty counters on it.
description:
Activate Jace's third loyalty ability by removing five loyalty counters from it, creating two token copies of Jace that aren't legendary, which each enter the battlefield with four loyalty counters on them due to Oath of Gideon.
Activate a Jace token's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it.
Activate a Jace token's third loyalty ability by removing five loyalty counters from it, creating two token copies of Jace that aren't legendary, which each enter the battlefield with four loyalty counters on them due to Oath of Gideon.
Repeat from step 2.
